title: Botafogo moves forward with signing of defender Arthur Chaves
seoTitle: Botafogo signs defender Arthur Chaves on loan
subtitle: The 25‑year‑old defender arrives on loan at the red‑and‑white club, with a mandatory purchase clause tied to contractual targets.
excerpt: The news of Arthur Chaves joining Botafogo from Germany's Hoffenheim is the main reason the 25‑year‑old defender is currently a hot topic.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The imminent arrival of defender Arthur Chaves at Botafogo is the main highlight that makes the 25‑year‑old player's name one of the most sought after today. The red‑and‑white club has moved forward with the signing of the defender, who belonged to Hoffenheim in Germany, generating great expectations among fans and in the football market.

Botafogo reaches agreement for defender Arthur Chaves

Botafogo completed the deal to have Arthur Chaves on a one‑year loan. The Rio de Janeiro club will pay one million euros, roughly R$ 6 million, for the transaction. The deal includes a mandatory purchase clause linked to contractual targets, such as the number of appearances. If that clause is met, the total value of the negotiation would reach 6 million euros, about R$ 35.8 million.

Defender’s trajectory in European football

Developed at Avaí, Arthur Chaves had a stint with Académico in Portugal at age 21 in 2022. Two years later, Hoffenheim showed interest and signed him for 6 million euros. In his first Bundesliga season, the centre‑back established himself as a starter and featured in 36 games in 2024/25. However, the second season did not go as expected, and Chaves lost playing time, being loaned to Augsburg in the second half of the campaign, where he started nine of 11 matches.

Player’s characteristics and potential

Internally, Arthur Chaves is assessed as a high‑potential athlete. Although he was not in his best form in Europe, the defender is right‑footed and can operate on either side of the back line. He is described as a fast defender with good tactical reading and effectiveness in one‑on‑one duels. Aerial ability, both defensively and offensively, is also highlighted as a strong point.

The restructuring scenario at Hoffenheim

Arthur Chaves’ departure comes during a restructuring period at Hoffenheim. The German club has already said goodbye to 22 players since the transfer window opened, through loans and permanent transfers. The team was not initially inclined to loan the player. Arthur Chaves has an estimated market value of 5 million euros (R$ 30 million), and Hoffenheim aimed to recoup part of the investment made in the player.

Interest from other clubs

The signing of Arthur Chaves by Botafogo was a contested market. The defender had previously been targeted by the red‑and‑white side on other occasions. In this window, Vasco and São Paulo also showed interest in the player within Brazilian football. Additionally, other German sides and Turkish clubs were watching the centre‑back.

With information from O GLOBO, Trivela.
